allVisibleCapturedMeaning: true = every quest VISIBLE to this profile was captured, completed, active, failed, or listed-but-locked, across every tab the trader shows. It does NOT mean every quest the trader has: anything still gated behind an unfinished quest or an unreached loyalty level is not on screen and is therefore not here. No trader in this collection is complete in the absolute sense.
allVisibleCapturedNote: LL1-LL4 plus the essential group were all sent. The essential group holds a single quest.

profile.note: Confirmed PvE on 2026-08-10; see the Fence batch, whose [PVE ZONE] cards carry ids that exist only in tarkov.dev's pve task list.
profile.factionNote: USEC. DETERMINED FROM THE COLLECTION ITSELF, not something written down at capture time. Four quests are faction-exclusive with no counterpart id: Road Closed (USEC), Green Corridor (BEAR), Our Own Land (BEAR) and Counteraction (USEC). "Road Closed" is ACTIVE on this profile, and the wiki says outright that it is "only obtainable by USEC PMCs" with Green Corridor as its BEAR counterpart. Both BEAR-only quests are absent from Prapor's list, which was captured in full. A BEAR profile could not show Road Closed and would have to show the other two, so the reading is unambiguous.

reading: Read off the in-game quest screen. Objective text is verbatim, including the (Optional) prefix.

quests.lineShattered: THE SPA TOUR LINE WAS BROKEN UP INTO UNRELATED QUESTS. Three of its parts turn up in this one Peacekeeper tab under names that share nothing with each other or with the original: 'Spa Tour - Part 3' is now Fuel Shortage, 'Part 5' is Master Key, 'Part 7' is Chemical Experiments. That is a different pattern from the line-head renames (Part 1 keeps the base name, later parts get standalone titles), here the whole line dissolved. Every part was also cut down: 4 objectives to 2 here, 8 to 1 for Chemical Experiments. The wiki has all three right; tarkov.dev and SPT have none of them.

quests.name: Secret Message
quests.unknownToEverySource: NO SOURCE HAS THIS QUEST, and it sets a trap for content matching. The only quest in any source with a 12ga-shotgun headshot objective is tarkov.dev's 'Spa Tour - Part 1' (Scavs, 12ga shotgun, SHORELINE), which superficially resembles this one. It is not the same quest: that id's wiki page is 'One-Way Ticket', whose current content is an AUG on Factory, and the game lists One-Way Ticket separately in this very tab with exactly that. So tarkov.dev's STALE description of one quest happens to look like a DIFFERENT, newer quest, a matcher keying on content alone would have merged them. The fourth quest no source has.
objectives: Eliminate any target with headshots using a 12ga shotgun on Streets of Tarkov (15)

quests.notTruncated: 8 objectives against 12 in BOTH sources, on a scrolled card, exactly the shape a partial capture would take, so it is worth saying why it is not one. THE ORDER RULES IT OUT. The sources list four BMP-2 locates, then a LAV III locate, then the marks; the game interleaves locate-and-mark per vehicle (locate first, mark first, locate second, mark second...) and contains no LAV III or T-90 line at all. A truncated capture would show the source's first eight lines in the source's order, which would include the LAV III. This is a rewrite: reordered into pairs, with the LAV III and T-90 objectives dropped.
